signal: Nue raised a $20M Series A led by Inovia, is expanding AI across its quote-to-revenue platform through 2026, and counts OpenAI, Glean and Jasper as customers

email.body1:
Mike, saw Nue closed its $20M Series A and is rolling AI across the quote-to-revenue platform, with logos like OpenAI and Glean on board.

Scaling that fast usually means more SaaS accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Nue off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Nue.

Post-Series-A, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can, and most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap surfaces late, then it is a scramble to save the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Nue needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Nue.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nue's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A SaaS startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A SaaS motion? I will tailor it to Nue either way.
